notablePrerequisites: Zimone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing it.
When Thermopod dies, Yedora triggers, returning Thermopod from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Thermopod enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning the creature face-up.
Resolve the Thermopod ability from step 1, adding {R}.
Repeat.
